Overview.Name: Jaya Lakshmi Athram
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Goal: Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal

Breakfast: Option 1: Oats porridge (60 g) + berries (50 g)
Lunch: Option 1: Brown rice (150 g) + dal (150 g) + vegetable curry (100 g)
Option 2: Millet roti (2) + chicken curry (120 g) + salad (50 g)
Option 3: Chapati (2) + paneer curry (120 g) + salad (50 g)
Dinner: Option 1: Light vegetable soup (250 ml) + 1 chapati
Option 2: Grilled fish (120 g) + steamed veg (100 g)
Option 3: Mixed vegetable stir-fry (150 g) + millet roti

Notes_and_Tips: For PCOS focus on low GI carbs and balanced protein at each meal.
Limit refined carbs and sugary fried foods to manage insulin.
Include regular yoga and stress-reduction practices.
Prefer small protein-rich snacks to stabilize blood sugar.
